name: zurs-khqr-payment-worker
description: Authenticated Bakong KHQR polling worker for payment sessions created by the ZURS main ledger.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL for the worker watch ledger.

DATABASE_SSL.description: Set to true for managed Heroku PostgreSQL.

WORKER_API_KEY.description: High-entropy shared API key accepted only from the ZURS main site.

CALLBACK_HMAC_SECRET.description: High-entropy HMAC-SHA256 secret shared with the ZURS main site callback verifier.

BAKONG_REGISTERED_EMAIL.description: Bakong-registered email used only for the official token renewal request.

BAKONG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Current Bakong bearer token. It is renewed through the official API when configured credentials permit.
